name: Neumorphic Wave Button
description: Round neumorphic icon button that presses into the surface on click while soft embossed ripple waves expand outward across the full colored background.
contents: Centered round button with lightning bolt icon
behavior: Click flips the button shadow from raised to inset and back, and fills the icon briefly
Each click spawns a ripple that grows, fades in then out, and is removed after its duration
editableByProps: Surface, highlight, shadow and icon colors
